To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the dynamic characteristics of the pneumatic muscle actuators with artificial muscles in antagonist connection were obtained by simulation models created in Matlab/SIMULINK environment.
the dynamic characteristics of pneumatic artificial muscle actuator in antagonistic connection can be simulated in Matlab/Simlulink environment.
the gear mechanism in the actuator is modeled by measured static characteristic and by equation of motion.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the modeling and simulation of a pneumatic actuator for obtaining of some of its dynamic characteristics.
the dynamic characteristics of the actuator with pneumatic artificial muscles.
the development and simulation of the dynamic model of pneumatic muscle actuators.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the dynamic responses of the position of the actuating arm are very similar for the both approaches to modeling of the gear mechanism.

the simulation of the designed model of the pneumatic actuator in Matlab/ Simulink environment using the gear mechanism with mathematical description is the most suitable approach for obtaining of some important dynamic characteristics of the actuator.
the simulation model of the actuator using the gear mathematical description is more accurate than the one using the measured and approximated actuator position characteristic.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the simulation of the actuator with artificial muscle is very useful tool for the analysis and design of the actuator.
the mathematical model of the gear mechanism using the equation of motion is more accurate and it is more suitable for the dynamic simulations of the actuator.

the simulation models of the actuator are very useful tools for the analysis of dynamic behavior of the actuator, for the design of its control system and for the comparison of different muscle models.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the simulation models of the pneumatic actuator are useful for analysis of dynamic behavior of this actuator in the Matlab/Simulinks environment and for the design of the control algorithms.
the gear subsystem of the actuator can be described in two ways.
the simulation model of the pneumatic actuator using the mathematical description of gear mechanism is very useful for the dynamic simulation of the actuator.
